"""Offline: tonight's rich#4147 record with the two probes' runs replaced by the hand-fixed probes' real outputs
(rich base 9d8f9a37 / head 3bd56b51, 3 runs each), re-judged with this branch's code. Three claim links."""
import copy, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from ops.daily_run import rejudge
from poc.final_verdict import final
P = Path(__file__).parent
SRC = Path("<live run case folder>")
base = json.loads((SRC / "record.json").read_text())
cl = {c["id"]: c for c in base["probe_plan"]["model_claims"]}
def runs(kind, c):
    return {side: [json.loads((P / f"out-{kind}-{c}-{sha}-{i}.json").read_text().splitlines()[-1])["observations"]
                   for i in (1, 2, 3)] for side, sha in (("main", "9d8f9a37"), ("pr", "3bd56b51"))}
def link(cid, expect, text):
    return {"id": cid, "source": "PR description", "text": text, "covers": [f"{cid}.*"], "expect": expect}
variants = {
  "orig_as_run": ("orig", {}),
  "fixed_as_run_no_claims": ("fixed", {}),
  "fixed_linked_model_claims": ("fixed", {"c1": [link("C1", cl["C1"]["expect"], cl["C1"]["text"])],
                                          "c3": [link("C3", cl["C3"]["expect"], cl["C3"]["text"])]}),
  "fixed_linked_preserve_claim": ("fixed", {"c3": [link("C3", "same", "Tags not adjacent to another tag are "
                                                      "highlighted as before (existing behavior preserved).")]}),
}
out = {}
for name, (kind, links) in variants.items():
    rec = copy.deepcopy(base)
    rec.pop("coverage_gate", None)  # let rejudge + gate recompute from scratch
    for it in rec["probes"]["items"]:
        c = it["id"].rsplit("-", 1)[-1]
        it["runs"] = runs(kind, c)
        it["claims"] = links.get(c, [])
        if links.get(c):
            for o in it["observations"]:
                o["name"] = o["name"].replace(f"{c}.", f"{c.upper()}.")
            it["runs"] = {s: [{k.replace(f"{c}.", f"{c.upper()}."): v for k, v in r.items()} for r in rs]
                          for s, rs in it["runs"].items()}
    f = final(rejudge(rec, SRC))
    flagged = (f.get("probes") or {}).get("summary", {}).get("flagged", [])
    out[name] = {"verdict": f["verdict"], "reason": f["reason"][:400], "flagged": flagged}
    print(name, "->", f["verdict"], "|", [(x["name"], x["label"]) for x in flagged][:6])
json.dump(out, open(P / "simulate-result.json", "w"), indent=1)
